source.training_license_gate: Use only rows whose per-row provenance explicitly verifies CC0-1.0.

primary_comparison.baseline: The hash-pinned released Open-Jev adapter and head, scored on the same selected rows.
primary_comparison.candidate: Heliox fine-tune initialized from that release, using the same candidate-conditioned scoring interface and temperature fit only on calibration rows.
metrics: overall and per-kind negative log likelihood
primary_comparison.acceptance: A research improvement requires candidate OOD top-1 accuracy no lower than baseline, lower aggregate OOD NLL, and no decision kind more than 5 percentage points below baseline. Otherwise reject the fine-tune and retain the released checkpoint as the stronger general decision model.

limitations: This compares against the released open-source Open-Jev checkpoint, not proprietary TypeSafe Jev.
No TypeSafe Jev outputs are collected, used as labels, or used for tuning.
This benchmark does not establish desktop task success, authorization, or execution safety.
No checkpoint from this protocol may be enabled for execution authority.
